content: Yaka abwe sauga etega boda Amoni wali kin Nahas wana tolohaveyan i ahel, hi na Isileli panuwana Yabesi, iyoho labi Giliyad elana, ge hi mipainan. Inoke Yabesi bolauiliyau gegewel hi na hi baek kin Nahas elana hi ba, “Ta pebabateli-agila alomeyau komiu ta mibubun, yaka naha minaa wam logugui gabulanaa.”

Yaa analiya kin Nahas i lahe i ba, “Nigeya! Iyai te ebo gegewemiu nuku talamwagimiu matamiu labena awomiwa na bwana yohil, yaka abwe alomeyau komiu ta pebabateli-agila. Na ginol ola o, yaka Isileli gegewemiu nuku puluwawi.”

Yaka Yabesi wali tonowakau hi awanun elana hi ba, “Lan ana gewi seben nu pem ga, inoke wama elopapatuna naha patunal nihi na Isileli gamwana gegewena elal wali wasa nihi pek. Ebo nige etega ni nenem ni lalabema, yaka abwe naha talamwagima eliyam wam nuwatu nu ginol.” Inoke wali awanun Nahas i talamwi.
Sauga elopapatuna hi novin Gibeya, Sol wana panuwaa, ge Nahas wana logugui hi wasaan, inoke gamagalau hi lokahin nabi analiya i bwata.

He sauga o elana, Sol i neem wana eyowaa i sisikal panuwaa, alonau ge wana bulumwakau bolo i patuwalali-agil wana eyowaa. Inoke kahin bwabwatana i hago, yaka i nel gamagalau enuna elal i ba, “Hauna gun i gan gamagalau elal? Hi bwe ge hi lolokahin?” Yaka wana wasa hi pek i ola to hauna Yabesi wali elopapatuna hi wasaan elal.
Sauga wali baaba i hago, yaka Yabowaine Yayaluwana wana gasisi i lau elana ge i huga nabi kin Nahas kaiwena.

Yaka bulumwakau labui i ahel i tagapaaligal ge tuwaliya i gotomwatomwa-agil, inoke i pek elopapatuna elal ge i ba hi kalivail pwapwati Isileli gamwana gegewena elal, ge hi ba, “Henala nige ni nonouliulil Sol ge Samuwela eliyaa ge ni hahaveyan boda Amoni elal, he wana bulumwakau nihi gotomwatomwa-agil ni ola hiwe!” Sauga gamagalau baaba o hi hago, inoke Yehoba i palovakun-agil kaiwena wana gasisi hi kiteya Sol elana. Yaka bolau gegewel hi boda pamaisena ge hi tagil toyawa nige etega i miminaa panuwaa.
Inoke Sol i pamigogoil panuwa Bisek elana ge i pwawa bolau bolo hi neem Isileli ali gewi tili handeled tausan (300,000), ge bolo hi neem Yuda ali gewi teti tausan (30,000).

Inoke hi baek elopapatuna bolo hi neem panuwa Yabesi elana hi ba, “Nuku na nuku baek alomiyau eliyalil te bwaligumwa mulaa abwe alalati bwagatau, ama naha pwamwalimiu.” Sauga elopapatuna hi sikal hi na Yabesi wali wasa hi pek, inoke hi yaliyaya nabi.
Yaa hi baek Amoni elal hi ba, “Bwaligumwa naha talamwagima eliyamiu, yaka hauna ku nuwatuan nuku ginol ya.”

Sol wana tolohaveyan i walel boda eton, yaka mweluluga kekeisi hot nigeya ga didiga i totomwa te hi vin, hi na hi tuk Amoni wali abaholaviya ge hi mimi lololil ana siga alalati bwagatau. Bolo hi mwal, hi lou waliwali, maisena ge maisena tomaha hi nonoek.
Isileli Sol Hi Patunahot Iya wali Kin
Haveyan enaa, yaka Isileli wali tolohaveyan hi nel Samuwela elana hi ba, “Bolau bolo hi ba nige nuwaliya Sol ni tabwa kin heliya ga? U ahel nihi nem eliyama yaka naha tagapaaligal.”
Yaa Sol i baek elal i ba, “Nige gamagal etega ta tatagapaaliga, kaiwena lan ebe Yehoba Isileli i pwamwalila ala topihigelgel elal.”
Yaka Samuwela i baek gamagalau elal i ba, “Ta na panuwa Gilgal ge ta patunahot te Sol iya wala kin.”
Inoke gegewel hi nok, yaka Yehoba manininaa Sol hi patunahot iya i kin. Inoke heliheliyam powonina hi ginol Yehoba manininaa, yaka Sol alonau ge gamagalau hi anan toyawa ge hi yaliyaliyaya.
